description: Store a document (passport, insurance, certificate, warranty, license, other) with its reference number, issuing authority, fee and notes. Optionally file it against a pet, vehicle or appliance with linkedEntityType and linkedEntityId. Returns the new id, which an appliance, vehicle or pet can link to.

examples.notes: Renew before the next family trip.
examples.title: UK Passport

documentNumber.description: Reference or serial number, e.g. a passport or policy number.

fee.description: Cost, e.g. a renewal or issuance fee.

currencyCode.description: Uppercase ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, GBP, JPY.

value.description: Amount in the currency's minor units. Most currencies have 2 decimal places (1599 = 15.99 USD), but some have none (1500 = 1500 JPY) and a few have 3 (12345 = 12.345 KWD).

linkedEntityId.description: Id of that pet, vehicle or appliance from list_pets, list_vehicles or list_appliances. Send with linkedEntityType.

linkedEntityType.description: Kind of record the document is filed against. Send with linkedEntityId.

examples: Renew before the next family trip.

renewalCronExpression.description: Accepted but not yet stored or acted on; has no effect.

title.description: Custom title. Defaults to type plus number, e.g. 'Passport - 512345678'.

name: create_document
